Analysis of a dainty silver chrismarium webbed in rainbow glaes filaments indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.
It may be altered but must remain made of metal, and the noun must remain chrismarium.
This chrismarium is at tier 4 out of 5.  It cannot be unlocked further outside of extraordinarily rare events.
It will hold a maximum of 80 charges.
It is currently using the "Rude" messaging style.

You can PUSH the chrismarium with a chrism in your other hand to store it within.  This destroys the chrism and adds one charge to the chrismarium.  The charges within the chrismarium are as effective as the average of all chrism gems absorbed in this fashion.
You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.
Unlocked verbs: PUSH, POUR, LOOK, MEASURE, RUB, PROD, PONDER, TILT, RAISE
The dainty silver chrismarium will cost 20,000,000 coins.

LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.

Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!
Instructions:
1. Hold your paint in hand
2. POUR your paint IN the Paint-in-ator 3000
3. Marvel at the relief to your shoulders as you shed weight
4. GAZE at your Paint-in-ator 3000 to see all the stored paints

1. PUSH a crystal amulet (or any of its cousins) into the Paint-in-ator.  (she's a hungry beast!)

5. TURN the Paint-in-ator to collect your paint or paintstick
Please note, any paints poured into the "Paint-in-ator 3000" are consumed by it and can only be retrieved using the methods listed above.
That's right, Brodega, it is that simple!

The Paint-in-ator has the following commands: gaze (displays all stored paint), nudge (cycles between paint and paintstick options), poke (turns on/off third person messaging for spin & tap), pour (adds paint to the device), prod (turns on/off long analyze), pull (removes crystal amulet from the device), push (adds crystal amulet to device), spin (cycles through available paint), tap (cycles through doses to create), turn (provides paint), and whisper (jumps to paint #)

Please be sure to always use the Paint-in-ator appropriately.  Drinking while using the Paint-in-ator forfeits all warranties, guarantees, and most lacquers.  Do not place your hands in the device while it is in use, as the creators will not be held responsible for missing digits. Analysis of a greyish hazelwood device indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!
Instructions:
1. Hold your paint in hand
2. POUR your paint IN the Paint-in-ator 3000
3. Marvel at the relief to your shoulders as you shed weight
4. GAZE at your Paint-in-ator 3000 to see all the stored paints
Retrieval Instructions:
1. PUSH a crystal amulet (or any of its cousins) into the Paint-in-ator.  (she's a hungry beast!)
2. TAP the Paint-in-ator to determine how many doses you want to retrieve (options: 1 - 5)
3. SPIN the Paint-in-ator to cycle through all the stored paint (50 is max)
4. NUDGE the Paint-in-ator to cycle between paintstick and vial options
5. TURN the Paint-in-ator to collect your paint or paintstick
Please note, any paints poured into the "Paint-in-ator 3000" are consumed by it and can only be retrieved using the methods listed above.
That's right, Brodega, it is that simple!

The Paint-in-ator has the following commands: gaze (displays all stored paint), nudge (cycles between paint and paintstick options), poke (turns on/off third person messaging for spin & tap), pour (adds paint to the device), prod (turns on/off long analyze), pull (removes crystal amulet from the device), push (adds crystal amulet to device), spin (cycles through available paint), tap (cycles through doses to create), turn (provides paint), and whisper (jumps to paint #)
The "Paint-in-ator 3000" is Tier 2 of 2.

Altering Instructions:  The Paint-in-ator must always be a box of some kind and must always be belt-worn.  Due to its complicated (patent pending) dials, chambers, switches, and toggles, it can never support a SHOW DESCRIPTION, but it can handle long descriptions.

Disclaimers:  The Paint-in-ator is a sensitive device and as such its creators wish to remind you that it is made for good fun.  As a result, it has restrictions on it to prevent the harm of small children and animals.  The creators do not want any accusations of "The Paint-in-ator ate my baby!"  Please be sure to always use the Paint-in-ator appropriately.  Drinking while using the Paint-in-ator forfeits all warranties, guarantees, and most lacquers.  Do not place your hands in the device while it is in use, as the creators will not be held responsible for missing digits.  And, for the love of all that is holy, do not bring a knife anywhere near it.  Do not use in the bath, as the creators will not be held responsible for what may happen.  For your safety, do not break these rules.

Solhaven.name: a cire leather herb kit scuffed at the corners

raw: With a copper latch to secure it, the kit features numerous compartments arranged within its waxed linen-lined interior.  A squat contraption bristling with visible gears and flywheels nestles deep within, connected to a scalloped armature.  A brushed copper toggle protrudes from the lining near a seam, and an acantha-etched knob is mounted inside the kit's rim.
It is estimated that a cire leather herb kit scuffed at the corners can store a medium amount with enough space for any number of items.
The kit can be worn, attaching it to the belt.  The kit appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of leather, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a cire leather herb kit scuffed at the corners indicates the creator has provided the following information:

The leather herb kit is a Survivalist's Kit, which is a specialized container for storing healing herbs.  All herbs stack up to 50 by default and maintain the weight of a single dose.  Doses may be removed one at a time from within the kit.  Herbs may be discarded from the kit entirely by PULLing on them.  The kit otherwise functions as a normal container that may be altered, lightened, and deepened per standard guidelines.
This kit has the Liquid Storage unlock, which allows it to store liquid herbs in addition to their solid counterparts.  Liquid herb storage is affected by any Capacity unlocks.

This kit has the Liquid Extractor unlock, which allows it to convert solid herbs into liquid over time (1 per 20 minutes).  The solid herb target must first be set by POINTing the kit at the appropriate dose of the herb inside of it, which should automatically begin the process.  You may then NUDGE the kit to stop (or restart) the extractor.  The extractor is currently targeting nothing.

This kit has the Potency unlock, which allows any liquid herbs that originate from the kit to be administered at a faster rate based on the consumer's Survival training.  This effect fades 30 seconds after the herb has been removed from the kit.
The kit will also respond to the following verbs: PEER (when not empty), CLEAN, GAZE, PINCH, RUB, TOUCH

Current herb stock: The kit contains DOSEs of the following solid herbs: basal (52), sovyn (150).  The kit contains TINCTUREs of the following liquid herbs: acantha (101), ambrominas (55), wolifrew (149), rose-marrow (125), basal (45), ephlox (123), bolmara (148), aloeas (146), pothinir (134), cactacae (55), torban (149), haphip (127), talneo (96), calamia (125), woth (150), brostheras (146), wingstem (136), bur-clover (150).
Unlocks:
Capacity: 5/5 (150 charges maximum per herb)
Liquid Storage unlock: yes
Extractor unlock (requires Liquid Storage): yes
Potency unlock (requires Liquid Storage): yes
The leather herb kit is set up with mechanical-themed messaging, which cannot typically be altered.
The following descriptions may be customized by a merchant:
- Inner lining description, in "adjective noun" form: waxed linen
This should be some form of fabric/leather.
- Container close mechanism, in "adjective noun" form: copper latch
This must end in one of the following: buckle, drawstrings, clasp, latch, toggle.
- Extractor indicator description, in "article adjective" form: an acantha-etched
- Extractor toggle description, in "article adjective" form: a brushed copper
You can tell that the kit is as light as it can get, but you might be able to have a talented merchant deepen its pockets for you.
The leather herb kit will cost 26,500,000 coins.

This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Eonak
Deity Primary Color:              Pale golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Brown
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

raw: A mirage-like haze of arcane influence clings to the jewel, alight with half-glimpsed glyphs refracting across its facets from within.  The effect is dizzying and makes further visual inspection difficult.

Rarity:      Common
Mnemonic:    twisttheknife

Description: You gain 2/4/6/8/10% damage factor against targets afflicted with major bleed.  When your warding spells are successful, the endroll is increased by 2/4/6/8/10 if the target is afflicted with major bleed.
Rarity:      Common
Mnemonic:    stormofrage

Grant the ability to cast a customized Miracle (350) involving fireworks.

First Person: As if placed by an invisible hand, a spluttering firework appears at your head and spits bright white sparks upon the ground.  Soon others join the first, and a chorus of alchemical hissing fills the air.  One by one, they explode with a dazzling display of bright azure, viridian, and magenta hues that completely blinds you.  A laughing voice welcomes you back to the party that is life, and as it does you draw breath, feeling alive once more.

Others' View: As if placed by an invisible hand, a spluttering firework appears at Brodega's head and spits bright white sparks upon the ground.  Soon others join the first, and a chorus of alchemical hissing fills the air.  One by one, they explode with a dazzling display of bright azure, viridian, and magenta hues that are brilliant and blinding.  As the light recedes, Brodega lays stunned and prone but full of life.

The effect of this token is cosmetic.  It does not increase the effect or damage caused by a spell.

This is a tier 2 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Phoen
Deity Primary Color:              Bright golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Blue
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.
It may be altered but must remain made of metal, and the noun must remain chrismarium.
This chrismarium is at tier 4 out of 5.  It cannot be unlocked further outside of extraordinarily rare events.
It will hold a maximum of 80 charges.
It is currently using the "Standard" messaging style.

You can PUSH the chrismarium with a chrism in your other hand to store it within.  This destroys the chrism and adds one charge to the chrismarium.  The charges within the chrismarium are as effective as the average of all chrism gems absorbed in this fashion.
You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.
Unlocked verbs: PUSH, POUR, LOOK, MEASURE, RUB, PROD, PONDER, TILT, RAISE

This Unlock Certificate applies an improvement or service as described below.  It may not be changed in any way.
Unless otherwise stated, it may be used at any time and does not expire.  Additional usage may apply.
Usage:  APPRAISE       Check eligibility
REDEEM         Apply the improvement
A timeworn location swatch grants the ability to change the worn location of an unscripted, wearable item.
DETAILS:
> Armaments are ineligible, with the exception of greaves.
> DB items, EZ Scripted items, and items with Flourishes are ineligble.
> Arm and leg greaves may only swap between the Arms (14) and Legs (15) locations.
> Only containers can be processed as a container, and they must be empty at the time of redemption.
> Container capacities will not increase (only decrease or be removed).
> Pockets are removed if a container becomes a non-container or is changed to a location that does not
support containers.
> The resulting noun is dictated by the new worn location and original item properties.  Only wood and
metal items can be processed as wood and metal, respectively.
> Locations with only base and container nouns will change non-leather items to cloth.
> Non-leather containers, socks, undershirts, and leggings will be changed to cloth.
> Items that are organic or lacking a material will be handled as non-metal and be changed to cloth,
with the exception of greaves, which default to plain metal.
> The resulting base/long description generally follows "a/an/some <material> <noun>."
> Wood and metal items that change to cloth will have their material preserved based on the resulting
noun, such as "<material>-brimmed" for hats.
> Show descriptions will be removed.
> Use LOOK        to view the current settings and preview a held item's changes (if applicable).
> Use TILT        to toggle processing a container as a container.    Currently: Yes
> Use TURN [to #] to toggle to the next or a specific worn location.  Currently: PIN
> Use TWIST       to toggle between arm and leg greaves locations.

An oval cabochon of translucent scarlet bloodstone is set within the pendant.  Thready veins of nacre wend beneath the stone's surface and ripple with a gentle, pulsing rhythm reminiscent of blood flow.
The pendant can be worn around the neck.

Bloodstone Jewelry
The bloodstone pendant has been infused with the vitality of an Empath and is tier 2 with 100 of 100 charges remaining.
The bloodstone pendant is not currently attuned to anyone.
Tier 1:  Altered State
Grants enhancive attributes of +20 max health, +10 max mana, and +5 max stamina per tier.
Tier 2:  Augmented Recovery
Grants enhancive attributes of +4 health, +2 mana, and +1 stamina recovery per tier.
Tier 3:  Vivacity
Activated ability to regain 20% of health, 10% of stamina, or 5% of mana every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.
- BESEECH pendant (HEALTH / STAMINA / MANA)
Tier 4:  Sanguine Swap
Store all existing wounds into the jewelry for 10 minutes, after which the wounds will automatically reappear.
- SPIN:  Initiate the transfer of wounds for a second time to transfer the wounds back early.
Tier 5:  Sanguine Sacrifice
Attacks deal an additional amount of concussion damage, occasionally overflowing to cause Major Bleed.

- PINCH: Toggle whether to enable the overflow capability.
The bloodstone pendant can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.
Alteration Guidelines
This item has not been locked to a final wear location and therefore may not be altered.
You may FLIP the bloodstone pendant to change its worn location until it is worn the first time.
Eligible locations include neck, wrist, ankle, finger, ear/ears, belt, hair, and pin-worn.
The bloodstone pendant will cost 4,000,000 coins.

3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

A fragile filigree mask framing one eye in the shape of a star can be detailed with both a long and a show description.  However, the noun cannot be changed, and part of the LOOK has a portion that cannot be altered.  A merchant can help you with changing your mask so that it either covers your entire face; or covers the upper part of your face (including your nose); or covers the upper part of your face (but not your nose).  [Note that this is in regards to the "face," "nose," and, when applicable, the "dmark" feature slots.]  A merchant can help you change what the fastenings look like, though they must remain something that logically ties (cording, ribbons, strings, etc.).

Note that customizations cannot use speech.  (* preceding any phrasing indicates customized phrasing is in use on this particular item.)
(NUDGE (cover face)) employing a mysterious manner, you position your filigree mask to cover your face and tighten its fastenings.
(NUDGE (uncover face)) smiling cryptically, you loosen the fastenings of your filigree mask and pull it down, revealing your face.
(RAISE) You adjust your filigree mask ever so slightly, drawing attention to the secretive smile written upon the curve of your lips.
(TWITCH) Your fingertips trail over the edge of your filigree mask as your lips twitch up in an enigmatic smile.

Bloodstone Jewelry

Tier 1:  Altered State
Grants enhancive attributes of +20 max health, +10 max mana, and +5 max stamina per tier.
Tier 2:  Augmented Recovery
Grants enhancive attributes of +4 health, +2 mana, and +1 stamina recovery per tier.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct bright silver battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen

raw: A faint muted black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct bright silver battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct bright silver battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Zelia
Deity Primary Color:              Bright silver
Deity Secondary Color:            Muted black
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 1,500,000 coins.

Analysis of a black-lined lunar eclipse panel indicates the creator has provided the following information:
ALTERATION GUIDELINES

Panel's Appearance: No long or show descriptions, noun must remain panel, article/adjective must describe an image and make sense as both art/adj/panel and art/adj/illusion (do not reference materials).

Concealed Illusion: A skilled merchant may alter the concealed illusion.  Supported customizations include article/adjective, custom long description (noun must remain illusion), and "show" descriptions.  Keep in mind that the illusion itself is a magical creation that is intangible and very obviously an illusion.  These are guidelines, and the merchant always has the final say over what they can or cannot do.

Illusion Color: Must be one or two words that are simple and obvious representations of color.  Avoid words that could be mistaken for an object or that qualify the color's properties.  The chosen color must make sense when describing magical illusion energy.  Great choices include: white, crimson, cerulean, viridian, periwinkle, or colorful.  Avoid words like: lemon, iridescent blue, faded grey, terracotta, or copper.

Illusion Material: Must be a word or short phrase that describes the temporary form taken by the magical illusion energy.  Must always be plural.  Must not reference color in any way.  Any adjectives describing the material MUST occur after a color adjective when considering rules for adjective-order.  In many of the illusion style messages, the illusion color directly precedes illusion material and so they must make adjective-order sense.  The material options that make the most sense will often be light, airy, individually distinct, transparent, and/or reflective.  Great choices include: motes of light, bubbles, ethereal leaves, water droplets, smoke wisps, or sparks.

List Customizations: These customizations are chosen as a number from a pre-made list: Illusion Style, Gesture Style, and Illusion Modifier.  Not all options are available at every merchant.  You must provide any dye additive in addition to the service fee when requesting an Illusion Modifier.  Here is the list of gesture styles: 0-subtle 1-complex 2-comical 3-abrupt 4-flamboyant 5-exaggerated 6-muted 7-stiff 8-formal 9-lazy 10-graceful 11-sharp 12-disjointed 13-angular 14-careful 15-wild 16-sweeping

This skyglass raxiara is a Dreamfire Panel Bracelet, capable of creating illusions.  The raxiara is intended to be used in conjunction with imagery storage objects, such as Dreamfire Illusion Panels.  Although these devices were originally designed by erithian artists for use in storytelling, their usage has expanded dramatically after introduction to other cultures.  It is not uncommon to find such devices being coveted by collectors, fortune tellers, gamblers, or anyone with an eye for unusual magical devices.
CUSTOMIZATIONS
Unlock Tier: 2/5                   Illusion Style: #0-Air Release*
Attachments: 5                     Gesture Style: #10-Graceful*
Mana Stored: 0/40                  Illusion Color: colorful*
Metallic: yes                      Illusion Material: motes of light*
* These properties can be overridden if the active panel has them set.
VERBS:

Tier 1: wear/remove (messaging), push/pull (attach/remove panels), rub (create illusion from panel appearance), peer (review all panels at once), look/show (appends attachment count and current panel information).
Tier 2: infuse (add mana), wave (create concealed illusion), snap (fluff), gaze (quietly preview current panel).
Unlock Tier 3 to gain verbs: flip, tilt, and waggle.
Unlock Tier 4 to gain verbs: tickle, point, and dismiss.
Unlock Tier 5 to gain verbs: nudge and pinch.
Attachment Points: 2+ turn (cycle panels), 3+ twist (silently cycle panels), 3+ turn/twist raxiara to # (choose active panel), 5+ fidget (randomly select panel).
Add more attachment points to gain verbs: spin (8+), empty (10+), flick (12+), lower (15+), and prod (15+).

Analysis of a voluminous suede cowl dyed in stygian black tones indicates the creator has provided the following information:
---- Animalistic Spirit Headdresses ----
=General Script Information=
This is headgear with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.
The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing attacks against like-level foes, either magical or physical.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
If you also wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon, shield, or wear a set of associated armor, the infusion within the cowl allows for all spirits to be tamed faster.
The spirit within the cowl can be unlocked to allow it to morph into the appearance of the spirits within any other Animalistic Spirit item you are also bonded with.

In addition, the cowl will draw out help from other wielded Animalistic Spirit gear when performing an Animalistic Avatar attack, adding Animalistic Fury (weapons/shields) or Animalistic Instinct (armor) to its attacks.

While wearing Animalistic Spirit armor, this cowl will take the place of the associated head coverage (if the armor has no head coverage), or be appended to the head coverage's description (if the cowl is not a helm/helmet) in the armor's messaging.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this cowl are fine.
* Any merchant can change the adornment, adornment type, and how the adornment attaches to the cowl.
Possible adornment types are: plain (color/texture), loose/dangling (feathers/tassels), reflective attachments (pins/gems/metal), rigid protrusions (spikes/horns), or designs (embroidery/etching).
* If the cowl is NOT a helm/helmet, it is likely a merchant can change the headgear type.
Possible types are: headdresses, helms/helmets, tiara/circlets, crowns, headscarves/turbans, hats, or hoods.
* Customization of the line that shows up in your features when worn is also possible, but only the segment after the comma in the first sentence and the complete second sentence can be changed.
NOTE: This should NOT indicate movement, glowing, or anything other than a description of how the adornment looks on the cowl when worn, or how the cowl is being worn.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
Only the "main" spirit can be altered in this manner; any spirit imprints cannot be changed.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Feature-Worn
When worn, this cowl can be viewable in your features, appearing just below the line indicating your race.  It is toggleable with TOUCH.
Feature-Worn ability is currently: ON [Toggle with TOUCH]
* Temporary Eye Feature Change
RUBbing the cowl causes the spirit's essence to briefly infuse your eyes, turning them into "feral misty green eyes" for 4 hours.
* Animalistic Apparition = Unlocked

When unlocked, the cowl gains the ability for a representation of the current spirit to appear after your inventory when people LOOK at you.  You can toggle this with SPIN, which can also change what mood the spirit will appear like to others.
Animalistic Apparition is currently: ON - Aggressive [Toggle with SPIN]
* Spirit Imprints = Unlocked [4 Possible Spirit Imprints]

When unlocked, the cowl gains the ability to "imprint" with other spirits and morph into their appearance at will.  The spirit within the cowl must be attuned to you, as well as the spirit of the other piece of Animalistic Spirit gear you are trying to imprint.

Use INSPECT to view any imprinted spirits, TURN to coax the spirit within the cowl to morph into a different spirit appearance, CLEAN to remove a spirit imprint, and POINT the cowl at the other item you want it to imprint to.
NOTE: You can only unlock a maximum of 4 extra slots for imprinted spirits on this cowl.
* Animalistic Avatar = Unlocked [Tier 4 of 4, Multi-Opponent Unlocked]

When unlocked, gain access to a maneuver-based attack using WAVE that briefly turns you into the avatar of the attached spirit, potentially rooting the target to the spot in fear.  This can be unleashed every 6 minutes.
If the multi-opponent version is unlocked, the same attack can be unleashed on a maximum of 6 creatures in the room once an hour.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, or wear Animalistic Spirit armor, the respective item's flare will be added to the cowl's attack.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 3 of 3)

At this tier, this cowl captures the following: WEAR, REMOVE, RUB (Temporary Eye Change), TOUCH (Feature-worn On/Off), NOD (targeted/untargeted), SHAKE (targeted/untargeted), TILT (targeted/untargeted), GROWL (targeted/untargeted), GAZE (targeted/untargeted), BOW (targeted/untargeted), ROLL (targeted/untargeted), SLAP (targeted/untargeted).
Use PROD to make the spirit less visible while using these actions [Spirit is currently: Awake]
* Tameness/Affinity
Tame the spirit to prevent it enacting its rage upon you.
Only one person can have allegiance to this cowl's spirit at a time.
The feeling of this spirit toward someone else is irritable (Level 5 of 12).
NOTE: To switch this cowl's allegiance to you, you must drop its tameness to the previous owner by damaging like-level creatures with physical or magical attacks.

This tent is an auction-quality tent.  It will withstand knockdown by creatures and can hold three guests.  This tent has been unlocked to accommodate an additional two guests.

Exterior:
a void black canvas tent flying a distorted pentagram flag
Interior:
[Champion's Respite]

Made of heavy black canvas, the walls block much of the light and sounds coming from outside.  Veniom-enforced steel framework holds the canvas aloft, jointed to allow for quick set up and take down.  Plush black furs are spread out across the floor.  Hanging from the tent poles above is an unlit brass oil lamp.  A patinaed copper spittoon is tucked into one corner of the tent beside a darkly varnished maple footlocker.  The scent of mildew permeates the air.
When the lamp is lit:

Made of heavy black canvas, the walls block much of the light and sounds coming from outside.  Veniom-enforced steel framework holds the canvas aloft, jointed to allow for quick set up and take down.  Plush black furs are spread out across the floor.  Hanging from the tent poles above is a polished brass oil lamp.  A patinaed copper spittoon is tucked into one corner of the tent beside a darkly varnished maple footlocker.  The scent of mildew permeates the air.

The room interior can be altered to reference a placed lantern, bedroll, storage container, trash can, or scent.  If not referenced, additional sentences will be appended to display them.  There is a 511 character limit total on the room descriptions.  Any items not referenced will show in the room as "You also see...".  The items will not be linked in the room description; you can ANALYZE inside the tent to see the items that are placed there to interact with.
You can STAND the tent to pitch it, and FOLD it to take it down.  You can also CLEAN, LEAN, or KNOCK on the tent.
PLACE the following items in your tent to store or remove them from the room:
* Perfume bottles, oil lamps and oils, or incense to impart a temporary fragrance to the tent.  The scent is currently: mildew
* One General Store lantern or torch, which can then be lit to light the room: a polished brass oil lamp is currently placed in the tent.
* One General Store bedroll; meditation mat; prayer rug; taxidermied rug; or folding chair:  None.
* One Pup Tent Storage Container: a darkly varnished maple footlocker is currently placed in the tent.
INVITE guests who are outside the tent inside.
PROD the tent flap to allow open access to the tent.

Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.  It is currently tier 4 of 5, which means it will house 24 food items.

This Veola item is designed to display a gem, feather, flower, insects and sea creatures, pointed items, or other miscellaneous items.  Miscellany includes other foraged items, skins, shells, and other larger non-gem treasure items.  The fascinator has several distinct descriptions, depending on what item is inserted.  To insert an item, hold the fascinator in one hand, the item you'd like to insert in the opposite hand, and PUSH fascinator.  PULLing the fascinator will remove the item and restore the fascinator to its empty description.  It has never been unlocked, but it could be by a qualified merchant.

When worn, it will temporarily alter your hairstyle and supports up to three custom hairstyles in addition to the default setting.  To change between the available hairstyles, hold the item in your hands and TURN it.  Currently it has no custom hairstyles set.
<hair> parted to the side and pinned back with an eyelet lace fascinator suspending a thin chiffon veil (default)<

When altering these items there is some important information to keep in mind.  First, this item belongs to the BARRETTE group and may only be altered in one of the following nouns without changing the group: Barrette, Haircomb, Fascinator, Cockade, Ornament, Headpiece, Ribbon(s), and Hairpin(s).  And while each side is highly customizable, both the noun and material do need to remain the same for all sides.
The sides currently are:
Short: eyelet lace fascinator
Gem/Button: an ivory eyelet lace fascinator adorned with a tiny <adj> bumblebee
Feather: an ivory eyelet lace fascinator backed by a spray of <adj>s
Flower: an ivory eyelet lace fascinator caught by a fall of <adj>s

Icemule Trace.name: a fragile filigree mask framing one eye in the shape of a star

raw: You see nothing unusual.  The mask dangles from silver-threaded silky ribbons, which can be tied loosely around the neck, where it will hang when not covering the face, or more tightly around the head to cover the nose and upper part of the face.
The mask can be worn anywhere on the body.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of cloth, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a fragile filigree mask framing one eye in the shape of a star indicates the creator has provided the following information:

A fragile filigree mask framing one eye in the shape of a star can be detailed with both a long and a show description.  However, the noun cannot be changed, and part of the LOOK has a portion that cannot be altered.  A merchant can help you with changing your mask so that it either covers your entire face; or covers the upper part of your face (including your nose); or covers the upper part of your face (but not your nose).  [Note that this is in regards to the "face," "nose," and, when applicable, the "dmark" feature slots.]  A merchant can help you change what the fastenings look like, though they must remain something that logically ties (cording, ribbons, strings, etc.).

A fragile filigree mask framing one eye in the shape of a star can be customized in the following manner, where any talented merchant can customize the bolded sections.  Note that customizations cannot use speech.  (* preceding any phrasing indicates customized phrasing is in use on this particular item.)
(NUDGE (cover face)) employing a mysterious manner, you position your filigree mask to cover your face and tighten its fastenings.
(NUDGE (uncover face)) smiling cryptically, you loosen the fastenings of your filigree mask and pull it down, revealing your face.
(RAISE) You adjust your filigree mask ever so slightly, drawing attention to the secretive smile written upon the curve of your lips.
(TWITCH) Your fingertips trail over the edge of your filigree mask as your lips twitch up in an enigmatic smile.
Currently you are able to use NUDGE, RAISE, and TWITCH.  This mask may only be unlocked further within special, rare circumstances.
The filigree mask will cost 500,000 coins.

raw: A faint deep indigo sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct silvery grey battle standard with a rippling deep indigo sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct silvery grey battle standard with a rippling deep indigo sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Ghezresh
Deity Primary Color:              Silvery grey
Deity Secondary Color:            Deep indigo
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

~*~ Nervestaves ~*~
SCRIPT DETAILS
The runestaff has a mechanical (combat) script which provides three basic types of functionality that can be broken down into the following categories:

AFFINITY - A special, custom 'bonding' like mechanism.  Any given item can share an Affinity with only one person at a time.  Affinity is gained by wielding the item and landing successful hits against like level foes.

BACKLASH - Potential negative effects, including immobilization, stuns, and nervous system damage, that can occur at random.  As the wielder's Affinity with the item grows, the chance of a Backlash occurring are reduced.

FLARES   - Off-the-Shelf, this item comes with a 'Muscle Memory' flare that, when triggered, will temporarily enhance the wielder's Combat Maneuver Ranks.  The magnitude of the enhancement is based on the degree of Affinity shared with the wielder, while the frequency of the flare is determined by the item's tier.

raw: Pieces of a woolly mastodon trunk, a niveous warg pelt, and a golden hinterboar mane dangle from the fel totem in some semblance of a decoration.
You sense only a single charge of power left in the fel totem.

Analysis of a fur-trimmed fel totem adorned with a flame-scarred dreadsteed skull indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Animalistic Totem --
This totem is an item that holds the spiritual essence of an animal.  The essence can be gained from animal-like creatures, familiars, animal companions, or Animalistic Spirit items.
==Features==
* Spiritual Essences [1 out of 5 Slots Unlocked]
POINT the totem at an appropriate animal-like creature, familiar, animal companion, or Animalistic Spirit item to have the totem absorb some of the creature's essence.
If you have more than one spiritual essence slot unlocked, you can use TURN on the totem to switch between the stored essences.
* Ambient Messages [ON - PROD to toggle]
While you are wearing the totem, the spiritual essence currently chosen will make itself known every so often with ambient messaging.  You can use PROD to quiet the spirit at any time.
* Animalistic Decoration

You can PUSH Foraged Items, feathers, bones/teeth, skins, and other small items into the totem and change its long description (the portion after the noun only).  Visit any willing merchant to change how each decoration type looks.  You can then PULL the totem to remove the item at any time.

While holding something made of metal, wood, or bone in one hand, you can ADD to the totem to change its base material.  CLEAN it to return it to how it looked initially.  WARNING: Materials used to change the totem's base material are lost forever, so be sure you are happy with what you choose.
* Accent Material Change [Locked]

Once unlocked, you can then TWIST the totem to focus on the accent material instead of the base material, allowing ADD to change the totem's article.  You can use CLEAN, as well, while focused on the accent material to return the totem to its original article.
Once an accent material has been added, you can use FLIP to adjust the article to different styles based on that material.
* Movement Styles [Locked]
When unlocked, you can allow the spiritual essence inside the totem to affect how you look when you move from room to room.  SPIN will select a style, while COVER will toggle the feature off.
* Wear Location Change [Unlocked]
When unlocked, you can use FOLD on the totem to switch between pin, wrist, and neck-worn locations.
* Bestial Power [Unlocked - T5 of 5,] Shifting Strike.]  (Flares: ON, RUB to toggle)
When unlocked, the spiritual essence inside the totem can help you passively in combat.  Only one of four paths can be chosen, and this cannot be changed once unlocked.
Abilities happen at a standard flare rate during combat if there are enough charges available.
Animalistic Endurance (Defensive) - +2 crit padding per tier.
Bestial Block (Defensive) - +3 DS/+2 TD per tier
Shifting Strike (Offensive) - +3 AS/+2 CS per tier
Feral Ferocity (Offensive) - +2 crit weighting per tier
The ability is fueled by skins from creatures, and up to 500 charges can be stored.
* Fluff Actions [Unlocked, T2 of 2.]
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations are fine, though the noun must be "idol", "totem", or "fetish".
* The adjective field should contain the material the totem is made of.
* This totem cannot accept a show description.

* Any willing merchant can change the designs for when feathers, bone/teeth, flowers, gems, bugs/sea creatures, or miscellaneous items are PUSHed into the totem.  These work much like Veolas, but the only part of the description you can customize is the part after the noun.
* Any willing merchant can change the color of the different spiritual essences.
==Usage==

You will find that you can use the following verbs: POINT (attune to a creature), ADD (add a material), PUSH (add a decoration), PULL (remove a current decoration), CLEAN (set material back to default), PROD (toggle ambient messages), FOLD (change wear location), PRAY, WAVE (targeted/untargeted), TOUCH, POKE, DROP/PUT (feed skins), RUB (toggle flares on/off).
You can TOSS the totem at a creature/object to send it in for review as a possible spiritual essence source.

This is a tier 2 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

Analysis of a mithril-bound short narwhal tusk indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The Ale Festival Drinking Horn
Designed to store liquid and will hold a maximum of 20 sips, though some special containers are offered that are unlimited.
Verb Traps: CLOSE, DRINK, MEASURE, OPEN, REMOVE, TURN, POUR*, WEAR
* POUR - This verb works one-way, allowing you to fill the tusk.
Unlocks:
Any dwarven merchant may unlock this item and any Ale Festival Merchant may as well.
Alterations:

The noun must remain horn or tusk.  The overall design must remain dwarven in nature.  Bandings, tips, and ornaments made of common dwarven materials like invar, mithril, and glaes, are encouraged in their descriptions.  Dwarves also like gems; feel free to adorn them with all types of gemstones found across Elanthia when altering these items.  Mundane and magical creatures alike throughout Elanthia can be used for the primary material of these drinking vessels as long as they have large enough horns or tusks to drink from.  (e.g. minotaur horn, ox horn, vor'taz horn, tsark tusk, boar tusk).
Customizations:

Lid/Cap option requires a noun (ie: lid, cap, cover).  Tip/end is the referencing point of the lid and can be either material or a gemstone.  Ornament can be a design that is carved into the side of the tusk and will always start with "the" in the areas it is displayed.  Strap/chain is referenced when wearing the tusk and should include a noun.  It will always be preceded by "the."  Clasp/buckle is referenced when wearing and removing the tusk.  It is the method by which the tusk is held in place.  It is always preceeded by "its" or "the."  When altering the solemn toast, capitalize the sentence and do not use punctuation.
Customization Fields:
Lid/Cap: bleached coral lid
Tip/End: mithril-bound end
Ornament: dwarven emblem
Strap/Chain: strap
Clasp/buckle: clasp
Solemn Toast: To kin and kegs.
Cheerful Toast: (ONLY VISIBLE WITH UNLOCK) - May your barrels never run dry!
Special Dwarven Abilities:
* Ability to drink from the tusk while it is worn.

raw: A faint silver sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.

This is a tier 6 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          0
Deity:                            Ronan
Deity Primary Color:              Night black
Deity Secondary Color:            Silver
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready
Ardent Plea [RAISE]:              Ready
Final Stand [BESEECH]:            Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
